en.headline: ERB to launch AI courses for working people from November
en.dek: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the Employees Retraining Board will partner with major technology firms to offer specialised artificial-intelligence training as part of a HK$50 million two-year programme aiming to…

zh.headline: 陳茂波：僱員再培訓局11月起為在職人士推出AI課程
zh.dek: 財政司司長在網誌表示，再培訓局將與大型科企合作推出專業人工智能課程，屬五千萬元「全民AI培訓」計劃一部分，兩年目標惠及約五萬人次。

en.headline: Wang Fuk Court buy-back deadline will not be extended, official says
en.dek: Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong confirmed nearly 95 per cent of owners have accepted the government offer, with the August 31 cutoff remaining firm and later statutory compensation expected to be substantially…

zh.headline: 黃偉綸：宏福苑收購限期8月31日不延期 近95%業主已接受
zh.dek: 財政司副司長表示截至上周五94.7%業主已簽署接受收購建議，餘約100戶，重申期限嚴肅，稍後法定收樓補償將明顯較低。

en.headline: Taxi driver dies after being hit while checking tyre in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A 67-year-old taxi driver was killed early Sunday when a private car struck him from behind as he inspected a burst tyre on Wan Po Road near Hong Kong Velodrome Park.

zh.headline: 將軍澳的士司機落車查爆胎遭撞斃 私家車男司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 周日凌晨一名67歲的士司機在環保大道因左後胎爆裂落車檢查時，被一輛私家車從後撞倒夾困，送院後不治，35歲私家車司機涉危險駕駛引致他人死亡被捕。

en.headline: Japanese lifestyle retailer LOFT returns to Hong Kong with one-year pop-up at MOKO
en.dek: After a 15-year absence the stationery and novelty specialist opened on Saturday at Mong Kok’s New Century Plaza, stocking about 3,500 products of which half are exclusive to the local market.

zh.headline: 日本生活雜貨店LOFT闊別15年重返香港 旺角MOKO設一年限定店
zh.dek: 文具及創意雜貨品牌周六於旺角新世紀廣場開業，店內約3,500款產品中有半數為香港限定，由引入3COINS的YAICHI集團營運。

en.headline: Local ice-cream brand TEEMTONEfai opens first permanent shop in Sheung Wan
en.dek: After a decade of pop-ups, the Hong Kong maker known for inventive flavours has settled at Upper Lascar Row with nine new Chinese-inspired scoops and soft-opening promotions through the end of August.

zh.headline: 本地雪糕品牌TEEMTONEfai上環開首間實體店
zh.dek: 成立十年後，以創意口味聞名的香港雪糕品牌終於在上環摩羅上街落腳，推出九款中式靈感新口味，試業優惠至八月底。

en.headline: Para Site’s 8th International Conference explores speculative tech futures at HKU today
en.dek: The free full-day event titled “Unsubscribe All!” runs from 10:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. at Wang Gungwu Lecture Hall, bringing together artists and thinkers from Hong Kong and abroad.

zh.headline: Para Site第八屆國際研討會今於港大探討科技推想未來
zh.dek: 名為「更新預設」的全日免費活動於上午10時半至下午6時在港大研究生堂王賡武講堂舉行，匯聚本地及海外藝術家與思想家。

en.headline: Peppa Pig’s Fun Day Out ends its Hong Kong debut today at East Kowloon Cultural Centre
en.dek: The interactive English-language musical, making its local premiere this weekend, stages its final performances on Sunday with shows at 11 am, 3 pm and 6 pm.

zh.headline: Peppa Pig音樂舞台劇香港首演今最後一日 東九文化中心上演
zh.dek: 互動英語音樂舞台劇《PEPPA PIG Fun Day Out!》周末於牛頭角東九文化中心首演，今日（23日）為最後一天，設上午11時、下午3時及6時三場。

en.headline: eHealth registration reaches 87 per cent of Hong Kong population
en.dek: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said more than 6.5 million residents have joined the electronic health system as it marks its tenth anniversary.

zh.headline: 醫健通登記人數突破650萬 佔全港人口87%
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂在十周年活動上表示，系統已連結逾4700間醫護機構及6.3萬名醫護人員。

en.headline: Police arrest two men over phishing texts that netted more than HK$500,000
en.dek: Officers found 110 SIM cards and a modem pool in a hotel room used to send nearly 2,000 scam messages about undelivered parcels and insurance fees.

zh.headline: 警拘兩男涉發釣魚短訊騙逾50萬 檢110張電話卡
zh.dek: 商罪科在酒店房檢獲「貓池」裝置及近2000條已發短訊，兩名內地男子涉嫌串謀詐騙被捕。

en.headline: Driver arrested for drug driving after three-vehicle crash in Pok Fu Lam
en.dek: A refrigerated-truck driver tested positive for cocaine after a collision that left a light-goods-vehicle couple trapped and injured on Saturday afternoon.

zh.headline: 薄扶林道三車相撞 冷凍貨車司機涉毒駕被捕
zh.dek: 周六下午薄扶林道近置富花園發生三車相撞，客貨車一對夫婦被困受傷，冷凍貨車司機對可卡因呈陽性反應被捕。

en.headline: Worker injured after scaffolding collapses in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: A 69-year-old man was trapped under debris when a section of bamboo scaffolding fell from a building on Nam Cheong Street and was later rescued conscious.

zh.headline: 深水埗南昌街棚架倒塌 69歲男工受傷被困獲救
zh.dek: 周六下午南昌街近汝州街唐樓外牆棚架倒塌，一名69歲男工被困瓦礫下，消防救出後清醒送院。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued for New Territories, extended into evening
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 5:52 p.m. and later extended it, expecting isolated thunderstorms over the New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告至晚間 預料新界局部有雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台下午5時52分發出雷暴警告，其後延長有效時間，預料新界有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Hong Kong to send more than 500 athletes to Nagoya Asian Games
en.dek: Culture, Sports and Tourism Secretary Rosanna Law said full funding is being provided for the Games and the final squad will be confirmed at the September flag presentation.

zh.headline: 港隊亞運派出逾500人 羅淑佩指政府全額資助
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局長表示運動員準備充足，正式名單下月初於授旗儀式公布，賽事9月19日開幕。

en.headline: Public hospital fee reform lifts full-waiver beneficiaries more than 20-fold
en.dek: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said government subsidy remains at 95 per cent after the January changes, with a five-year target of 90 per cent, while 17 new drugs have been added to the formulary.

zh.headline: 公院收費改革後全額豁免人數增逾20倍 政府仍資助95%
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，改革後政府資助維持95%，五年目標降至90%，藥物名冊已新增17種藥包括專科用藥。

en.headline: 10,000 civil servants take part in Huanggang port stress test
en.dek: The third major readiness exercise at the new Hong Kong Port Area tests full boundary clearance procedures, e-channels and vehicle booths ahead of the facility’s opening.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸港方區周六壓力測試 萬名公務員參與
zh.dek: 新皇崗口岸港方口岸區第三場大型演練測試全面通關流程、電子通道及車輛檢查亭，為口岸啟用作準備。

en.headline: Ukrainian Culture Day brings bazaar, workshops and music to Goethe-Institut
en.dek: The one-day event on Saturday features a free handicraft bazaar, embroidery exhibitions, workshops, Ukrainian food and two live music performances in Wan Chai.

zh.headline: 烏克蘭文化日歌德學院舉行 設市集工作坊及音樂會
zh.dek: 香港烏克蘭協會周六於灣仔歌德學院舉辦一日活動，包括免費手工藝市集、刺繡展覽、工作坊、美食及兩場現場音樂演出。

en.headline: Tourism chief confident Hong Kong will hit 53.8 million visitor target
en.dek: Rosanna Law said the first seven months delivered solid growth despite July rain and higher fuel costs, with the traditional peak season still ahead.

zh.headline: 羅淑佩有信心全年達5380萬人次訪港目標
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局局長指首七個月已錄得約3122萬人次，即使7月多雨及燃油成本上升，仍對下半年旺季有信心。

en.headline: Multiple collisions on North Lantau Highway disrupt airport traffic
en.dek: Ten accidents involving 29 vehicles left five people injured this morning near Siu Ho Wan, with temporary lane closures towards the airport.

zh.headline: 北大嶼山公路多宗車禍 往機場方向一度封閉部分行車線
zh.dek: 今早約兩小時內發生十宗交通意外，涉29輛車，其中三宗造成五人輕傷，運輸署曾封閉近小蠔灣部分行車線並呼籲市民乘搭港鐵。

en.headline: Hong Kong ToyCar Salon continues this weekend at Hopewell Hotel
en.dek: The three-day model-car exhibition in Wan Chai features more than 200 new releases, JDM display cars and a new aircraft model zone, running until Sunday.

zh.headline: 香港車仔展2026周末續於灣仔合和酒店舉行
zh.dek: 為期三日的模型車展匯集逾200款首發產品、JDM真車及新增飛機模型區，今日及周日繼續開放。

en.headline: Customs seize 118 kg of live pests and frozen rats at Man Kam To
en.dek: A 40-year-old local driver was arrested after officers found undeclared mealworms, cockroaches, fruit flies and frozen domestic rats mixed with declared goods.

zh.headline: 海關文錦渡檢118公斤活體病蟲害及冷藏白老鼠
zh.dek: 入境貨車混藏麥皮蟲、蟑螂、果蠅及冷藏白老鼠，40歲本地男司機被捕，市值約3.5萬元。

en.headline: Tuen Mun police arrest 22 in week-long youth crime crackdown
en.dek: Fourteen of those detained were students; offences ranged from drug trafficking and criminal damage to indecent assault, with six already charged.

zh.headline: 屯門警區反青少年罪惡行動拘22人 包括14名學生
zh.dek: 行動為期七日，涉販毒、刑事毀壞、非禮等多項罪名，其中六人已被落案起訴。

en.headline: Harry Potter Mahou Dokoro pop-up at Hysan Place closes on 25 August
en.dek: The limited-time store in Causeway Bay, stocking official apparel and collectables inspired by the films, has been open since late July and ends next Tuesday.

zh.headline: 哈利波特Mahou Dokoro期間限定店希慎廣場8月25日結束
zh.dek: 銅鑼灣希慎廣場B1層的官方主題期間限定店自7月24日開業，售賣電影靈感服裝及收藏品，下周二結束營業。

en.headline: MTR senior manager loses HK$74 m in alleged green-bond scam
en.dek: Police are investigating after a 59-year-old expatriate reported being lured over two years by a caller posing as an HSBC UK private-bank employee into transferring funds to overseas accounts.

zh.headline: 港鐵高級經理疑遭綠色債券騙案損失7400萬元
zh.dek: 一名59歲外籍港鐵高級經理報稱兩年間被冒充英國滙豐私人銀行職員的來電誘騙，向海外戶口轉帳約7400萬元，警方正調查。

en.headline: Sportfest Hong Kong continues at HKCEC with pickleball and new sports trials
en.dek: The three-day sports expo under the theme “Dare to Sport Dai Pai Dong” runs until Sunday, offering free experiences of emerging sports alongside competitions and a youth volleyball final.

zh.headline: 香港運動節會展續舉行 設匹克球及新興運動體驗
zh.dek: 以「敢運動大排檔」為主題的三天運動博覽進行至周日，提供匹克球挑戰、新興運動試玩及青年排球決賽等。

en.headline: AFCD to trial real-name booking for Po Pin Chau trail from September
en.dek: Daily visitor quota of 2,000 will apply on weekends and the Golden Week holiday period at the popular High Island Geo Trail section in Sai Kung East Country Park.

zh.headline: 漁護署9月起試行破邊洲實名預約 周末及黃金周每日限2000人
zh.dek: 西貢萬宜地質步道破邊洲段將於9月5日至10月7日周末、中秋及國慶黃金周實施預約制，每兩小時時段500名額。

en.headline: Government to review fighting-dog definition after fatal attacks
en.dek: Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan said the list of controlled breeds and related controls will be examined, with proposals aimed at LegCo within the year.

zh.headline: 謝展寰：檢討格鬥狗隻定義及名單 加強大型狗管理
zh.dek: 環境及生態局長指兩宗近期狗咬事件後將全面審視管控措施，爭取年內向立法會提交建議。

en.headline: CUHK team completes Hong Kong’s first robot-assisted pelvic fracture surgeries
en.dek: Three elderly patients treated since June with a new orthopaedic robotic system that reduced blood loss to 10–20 ml and shortened incisions to under 2 cm.

zh.headline: 中大完成全港首例機械人輔助盆骨骨折微創手術
zh.dek: 自6月起已為三名長者完成手術，術中失血僅10至20毫升，傷口縮至不足2厘米。

en.headline: ICAC charges HKU associate professor and three others over HK$2.2 m IT education bribes
en.dek: Gary Wong Ka-wai is accused of accepting cash rewards for awarding more than HK$10 million in purchase orders; the case is due for mention on Monday.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴港大副教授等四人 涉收賄220萬批出千萬IT教育項目
zh.dek: 黃家偉被指收受現金賄款後批出逾1000萬元採購訂單，案件下周一東區裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Meow-cation exhibition at DX design hub links cats, textiles and Sham Shui Po craft
en.dek: The community-driven showcase features a giant cat installation made from local textiles and runs until 2 November at the Hong Kong Design Centre venue in Sham Shui Po.

zh.headline: DX設計館《喵之旅》展出 以紡織與貓咪連結深水埗社區
zh.dek: 社區主導展覽以本地紡織物料製成巨型貓咪裝置，展期至11月2日，於深水埗香港設計中心場地舉行。

en.headline: CUHK head calls for better intellectual property training for scientists
en.dek: Vice-Chancellor Dennis Lo said researchers should patent their work and urged the government to consider an early-stage angel fund that is not too dilutive.

zh.headline: 中大校長促加強科研人員知識產權培訓
zh.dek: 盧煜明表示科學家應為研究成果申請專利，並建議政府考慮設立不太攤薄股權的早期天使基金。

en.headline: Weekend outlook: cloudy with showers and isolated thunderstorms
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects mainly cloudy skies with a few showers this weekend, more frequent at first on Saturday and later on Sunday, under a broad trough of low pressure.

zh.headline: 周末展望：多雲有驟雨及局部雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台預料周末大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，周六初時及周日稍後部分地區驟雨較多並有雷暴，受廣闊低壓槽影響。

en.headline: Hong Kong Alliance and two former leaders found guilty of inciting subversion
en.dek: A High Court panel sitting at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts convicted the disbanded group, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung; Albert Ho earlier pleaded guilty and all face sentencing later.

zh.headline: 支聯會及兩名前領導被裁定煽動顛覆國家政權罪成
zh.dek: 高等法院三名國安法指定法官裁定已解散的支聯會、前主席李卓人及前副主席鄒幸彤罪名成立；何俊仁早前認罪，各人稍後判刑。

en.headline: After Taste exhibition opens in Cheung Sha Wan tracing a century of Hong Kong dining
en.dek: Local studio artellex and private collectors present rare menus, calligraphic scrolls and antique cookbooks from 21 August to 27 September, by appointment only.

zh.headline: 《過去味來》長沙灣開展 重現香港百年飲食演變
zh.dek: 本地工作室artellex聯同私人收藏家展出珍稀餐牌、書法字頭及古籍食譜，8月21日至9月27日舉行，需預約參觀。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued overnight, cancelled at 5:45 am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 12:30 a.m. for isolated squally thunderstorms and cancelled it after dawn as the weather stabilised.

zh.headline: 天文台昨晚發出雷暴警告 今早5時45分取消
zh.dek: 天文台凌晨12時30分發出雷暴警告，其後延長至早上6時30分，預料局部地區有狂風雷暴，清晨5時45分取消。

en.headline: Cathay Pacific to launch direct flights to Almaty from January 2027
en.dek: The three-times-weekly service will be the airline’s first Central Asian destination and the only non-stop link between Hong Kong and Kazakhstan, subject to regulatory approval.

zh.headline: 國泰明年1月開通阿拉木圖直航 成中亞首個航點
zh.dek: 每周三班服務將成為國泰首個中亞目的地，亦是香港與哈薩克之間唯一直航客運航線，尚待當局批准。

en.headline: Customs seize three live cats at Lok Ma Chau Spur Line, arrest woman
en.dek: A 68-year-old mainland passenger was intercepted in the arrival hall with the animals in her luggage; the cats are valued at about HK$36,000 and the case has been referred to the AFCD.

zh.headline: 海關落馬洲支線檢3隻懷疑非法進口活貓 拘68歲女
zh.dek: 關員在入境大堂截查一名抵港內地女旅客，於行李內發現3隻活貓，估計市值約3.6萬元，案件交漁護署跟進。

en.headline: Woman found dead in Ta Kwu Ling with suspected animal bite marks
en.dek: Police are investigating after a 33-year-old woman was discovered collapsed outside a village house near a dog training centre and boarding facility on Thursday afternoon.

zh.headline: 打鼓嶺女子伏屍村屋外 身上疑有動物咬噬痕跡
zh.dek: 一名33歲女子周四下午在坪洋新村坪原路一村屋外被發現倒臥，當場證實死亡，屍體有懷疑動物咬噬痕跡，警方正調查。

en.headline: Domestic helper arrested after toddler suffers second-degree burns in Yuen Long
en.dek: A 30-year-old Indonesian woman was detained on suspicion of ill-treating or neglecting a child in her care; the 23-month-old girl remains in hospital under observation.

zh.headline: 元朗女童手部二級燒傷 30歲印傭涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 23個月大女童雙手燙傷送院觀察，印尼籍家庭傭工涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略，明日提堂。

en.headline: HAECO and CALC sign MOU to develop aircraft engine maintenance centre in Hong Kong
en.dek: The partnership will focus initially on quick-turn services, hospital repairs and engine asset management, according to the Transport and Logistics Bureau.

zh.headline: 港機工程與中國飛機租賃簽備忘錄 擬設引擎快修中心
zh.dek: 合作初期聚焦快修、大修及引擎資產管理，運輸及物流局指有助鞏固航空樞紐地位。

en.headline: July consumer prices rise 1.7% year on year as inflation stays moderate
en.dek: The smaller increase from June mainly reflected a rates concession; underlying inflation held at 1.9% after stripping out one-off relief measures.

zh.headline: 7月綜合消費物價指數按年升1.7% 基本通脹維持1.9%
zh.dek: 升幅較6月放緩主因差餉寬免，剔除政府一次性措施後基本通脹率與上月相同。

en.headline: Unemployment rate holds steady at 3.7% for May–July period
en.dek: The seasonally adjusted jobless rate remained unchanged while the underemployment rate edged up to 1.7%; total employment rose by about 1,500 people.

zh.headline: 5至7月失業率維持3.7% 就業不足率微升至1.7%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整失業率與上期相同，總就業人數增加約1,500人，失業人數增加約6,000人。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued until 8:30 pm as isolated storms affect Hong Kong
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 7:05 p.m., expecting isolated thunderstorms over the territory before cancelling it later in the evening.

zh.headline: 天文台傍晚發出雷暴警告至晚上8時30分
zh.dek: 天文台下午7時05分發出雷暴警告，預料香港有局部地區雷暴，有效時間至晚上8時30分。

en.headline: Customs arrest two over HK$35 million money-laundering linked to earlier drug case
en.dek: Financial investigation of a 2025 narcotics seizure uncovered suspicious transfers of about HK$35 million through the personal bank accounts of two 33-year-old local men between January 2024 and August 2025.

zh.headline: 海關跟進毒品案拘兩男 涉清洗黑錢約3500萬元
zh.dek: 根據2025年一宗毒品案財富調查，兩名33歲本地男子個人銀行戶口於2024年1月至2025年8月有大量可疑交易，涉款約3500萬元，昨被控處理犯罪得益。

en.headline: Police smash three drug stores in Kwai Chung and Tsuen Wan, arrest four including three…
en.dek: Officers seized ketamine, crack cocaine and other drugs worth more than HK$1.4 million; a 19-year-old is alleged to have recruited the three minors for storage, packaging and delivery work during the summer holiday.

zh.headline: 警搗葵涌荃灣三毒品倉拘4人 包括3名未成年少年
zh.dek: 檢獲氯胺酮、霹靂可卡因等市值逾140萬元毒品；19歲男子疑招攬3名16至17歲少年管倉、包裝及派送，每人報酬數百元，案件明日西九龍法院提堂。

en.headline: Transport Department to use AI for faster licence renewals and smart traffic lights
en.dek: Online vehicle licence renewals and cross-boundary permit applications are targeted for automated approval by year-end; a Causeway Bay junction will trial real-time pedestrian-priority signals from early 2027.

zh.headline: 運輸署推AI加快續牌及智慧燈號 銅鑼灣路口明年試行
zh.dek: 年底起用大型語言模型自動審批網上續領車牌及跨境駕駛計劃申請，目標九成自動批核、最長審批時間由10個工作天縮至1天；銅鑼灣告士打道路口明年首季試行實時燈號，行人最長等候可減15至20秒。
